question:
The Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) in India is fixed by _________.

(A) RBI

(B) SEBI

(C) Ministry of Finance
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only A.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is India’s central bank.

__
 
• In compliance with the terms of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, it was founded on April 1, 1935 in Calcutta.

 
 
• It was permanently moved to Mumbai in 1937.
 
 
 
• **Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) **is an important tool used **by the RBI to manage liquidity in the banking system and control inflation.**
 
• Though originally privately owned, since nationalisation in 1949, the Reserve Bank is fully owned by the Government of India.
 
• It also functions as the "lender of last resort" and is considered Banker to Banks.
 
• It regulates the issue of Bank notes and keeping of reserves with a view to securing monetary stability in India and generally to operate the currency and credit system of the country to its advantage.
 
• It also monitors the monetary policies through its Monetary Policy Committee (MPC).​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI):

 
• According to the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992, SEBI is a statutory entity that was founded on April 12, 1992.
 
• SEBI plays a crucial role in overseeing and regulating the securities market in India, ensuring fair practices, protecting the interests of investors, and promoting the development of the securities market.
 
• The Securities and Exchange Board of India's primary responsibilities are to uphold the rights of securities investors and to foster and oversee the securities industry.
 
• Mumbai is the location of SEBI's headquarters.
 
• To safeguard the interests of organizations that believe they have been wronged by SEBI's ruling, the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT) was established.
